survey.deceleration_fallback: _solve_impl feasibility fallback is guarded by 'and False' in this checkout

rod.motion: constant-speed reflected motion; body pose updated each capture

raised_start.method: the one warmed, wrist-constrained loop planner solves from the camera-front seed to world +0.20 m Z with the same tool orientation; the solved state is used directly as loop start and that solve is not executed as experiment motion

wrist_3_limit.method: load existing YAML into cuRobo RobotCfg, modify the in-memory JointLimits.position tensor before MotionPlannerCfg.create; IK, TrajOpt, and PRM receive the same RobotCfg

clock.model: ideal velocity integrator, previous command during measured compute; remainder to target period after result
clock.scoring_and_visual_rendering: offline, excluded as in v2 truth scoring
clock.acceleration_feedback: zero; no actuator dynamics or acceleration/jerk certification

prediction_rule: v2 directional stretch: 2 * velocity * (previous measured compute + 0.025 s)
